in_marathi.name: Raitik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raitik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raitik is a Sanskrit and Hindi name for a male. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rathi', meaning chariot or vehicle, and the suffix 'ik', meaning ruler. In Hindu mythology, Raitik is the name of the sun god, Surya, who is said to ride his chariot across the sky each day.
